article.title: In this West Bank village, the road to school runs through Israeli tear gas
article.author: Monjed Jadou
article.content: Settler attacks, army raids, and a checkpoint at the village entrance are cutting deep into the school day at al-Mughayyir Boys’ School in the Ramallah area of the occupied West Bank.
